hints.address2: Optional apartment, suite, or additional address line.
hints.city: City or locality for the default address.
hints.postalCode: Postal or ZIP code for the default address.
hints.countryCode: Two-letter ISO country code, for example PL or DE.
hints.notes: Private notes for your team. Never shown to the customer on the storefront.
hints.customTags: Add your own labels to segment or flag customers. Type a tag and click Add tag or press Enter.

security.title: Sign-in security
security.required: The admin panel opens only once two-factor authentication is on. Turn it on below with an authenticator app; from then on, signing in with your password also asks for a six-digit code.
security.requiredWithoutPassword: The admin panel opens only once two-factor authentication is on, and turning it on needs a password. This account signs in with Google and has no password yet, so set one below first, then turn on two-factor authentication.
security.optional: Two-factor authentication is optional in this environment, so the admin panel is already open. In production, the admin panel opens only once it is on.
security.enabled: Two-factor authentication is on. Signing in with your password also asks for a code from your authenticator app.

settings.title: Settings

maintenance.label: Maintenance mode
maintenance.description: Temporarily disable the storefront for visitors.

inventoryTracking.label: Inventory tracking
inventoryTracking.description: Automatically track stock levels for all products.

autoFulfillment.label: Automatic fulfillment
autoFulfillment.description: Automatically fulfill orders when payment is captured.

orderConfirmation.label: Order confirmation emails
orderConfirmation.description: Send a confirmation email when an order is placed.

cancelBlocked.openDispute: This order has an open dispute. Cancelling would refund its payment, which the dispute now decides, so the order cannot be cancelled until the dispute closes.

cancelDialog.title: Cancel order?
cancelDialog.description: Order {id} will be cancelled and its items returned to stock. There is no payment to refund. The customer is emailed about the cancellation. This action cannot be undone.
cancelDialog.refundDescription: Order {id} will be cancelled, its items returned to stock and the customer's payment refunded in full through Stripe. The customer is emailed about the cancellation and the refund. This action cannot be undone.

toast.emailFailedDescription: Resend did not take the “{email}” email. It is tried twice more within a few seconds. If it still fails, resend it from the order's Activity card, which also shows the error.
toast.emailAlreadySentDescription: The order already reached this step before, so the “{email}” email was not sent again.
toast.trackingEmailSentDescription: The order was already marked as shipped before, so the customer received only a short message with the current tracking number.
toast.cancelSuccessDescription: Order cancelled and its items returned to stock. A paid order shows the refund once Stripe confirms it.
toast.cancelEmailFailedDescription: Resend did not take the cancellation email. It is tried twice more within a few seconds. If it still fails, resend it from the order's Activity card, which also shows the error.
toast.errorDescription: Please try again in a moment.
toast.invalidStateDescription: This action is not available for the order's current state.
toast.openDisputeDescription: This order has an open dispute, which decides what happens to its payment. Until the dispute closes, the payment cannot be refunded and the order cannot be cancelled.
toast.refundSuccessDescription: Refund submitted to Stripe. The order updates once Stripe confirms it.
toast.restockSuccessDescription: The order's items are back in stock.
toast.resendEmailSentDescription: Resend took the email. The order's Activity card records it.
toast.resendEmailFailedDescription: Resend did not take the email. It is tried twice more within a few seconds. If it still fails, the order's Activity card offers Resend email again.

inpost.label: Download label

createDialog.courierDescription: InPost's courier delivers the parcel to the shipping address. Choose its size and enter its weight.

toast.createdDescription: InPost confirms it within a few moments. Refresh its status to get the tracking number and the label.

errors.invalidState: This action is not available for the order's current state.
errors.failed: Please try again in a moment.

shipDialog.title: Mark order as shipped
shipDialog.description: Add the tracking details the customer will see in their account and shipping email. Both fields are optional. Left blank, they keep the tracking number the order already has from its InPost shipment.

refundDialog.title: Refund this order?
refundDialog.description: This issues a full refund for order {id} through Stripe. The customer is emailed about it once Stripe confirms the refund.
refundDialog.restockLabel: The items came back to stock
refundDialog.restockHint: Tick this only when the goods are back in the shop, so they go on sale again. Leave it clear for a lost parcel or a goodwill refund; you can return them to stock from this order later.

restockDialog.title: Return the items to stock?
restockDialog.description: The items of order {id} go back on sale. Do this only once the goods are back in the shop. An order's items return to stock only once.

refundBlocked.noStripePayment: Nothing to refund: this order was free, so Stripe took no payment for it.

cancelBlocked.openDispute: This order has an open dispute. Cancelling would refund its payment, which the dispute now decides, so the order cannot be cancelled until the dispute closes.

subscribers.title: Subscribers
subscribers.description: Addresses signed up for the newsletter and where each subscription stands.

unsubscribeDialog.title: Unsubscribe this address?
unsubscribeDialog.description: {email} will stop receiving the newsletter, just as if they had used the unsubscribe link. No email is sent to them. To come back, they have to sign up and confirm again.
unsubscribeDialog.successDescription: {email} will no longer receive the newsletter.
unsubscribeDialog.errorTitle: The address could not be unsubscribed

eraseDialog.title: Erase this subscriber's data?
eraseDialog.description: {email} will be removed from the list along with its language, sign-up place and dates, and the audit log entries about its unsubscribing and its failed newsletter emails will be deleted, leaving only the record of the erasure. This cannot be undone. A customer account with this address, and its own entries, stay as they are.
eraseDialog.successDescription: {email} is no longer on the subscriber list.
eraseDialog.errorTitle: The data could not be erased

toast.errorDescription: Nothing has changed. Please try again in a moment.
